svg.title: Bayes decision boundary and irreducible classification error
svg.desc: Prior-weighted Gaussian density curves for two fictional production lines cross at 54.87 grams per square metre. The smaller curve at each measurement is shaded to show the 16.84 percent Bayes error caused by overlap.

cc:Work.dc:title: Bayes decision boundary and irreducible classification error
cc:Work.dc:description: Weighted Gaussian densities, their overlap, and the posterior decision boundary for two synthetic classes.
